notes: No convincing token-specific backdoor found in static weight analysis. Embedding row norms: median 0.53484, p99 0.97411, maximum 1.25579 (token 553), runner-up 1.21397 (645); high-norm rows have diverse class directions rather than one common target. Head row norms range 1.5314-1.8913, with no dominant classifier row; maximum absolute head bias is 0.13085. MLP fc1/fc2 top singular energy fractions are 0.2778/0.2842, and no isolated high-gain neuron or uniquely aligned token was found. Attention V/O Frobenius norms are 0.6344/0.4806. Per-head OV top singular values are 0.04348 and 0.14876, with energy fractions 0.8025 and 0.8953: concentrated but small in absolute gain. Raw embedding-to-class OV proxy maxima are 0.02552/0.07653 versus 3.99473 for the direct proxy. Direction-normalized head-1 OV leaders 721, 383, 131, 753 have similar scores (0.10480, 0.10362, 0.10077, 0.09992); query-bias key attraction likewise has multiple near-ties, not an isolated trigger. Unit-direction QK bilinear score ranges are [-0.04096,0.04249] and [-0.08571,0.09529]. Largest MLP proxy tokens do not uniquely dominate or agree with their direct class direction. Position norms are [0.88421,0.87566,0.82118,0.08281], distinguishing last position consistently with the stated readout, not establishing a position-specific attack. All scores are weight-path proxies, not logits or attention probabilities: centering and learned LayerNorm gains were included in selected products, but input-dependent LayerNorm scaling, GELU gating, softmax, and residual interactions were not evaluated. Comparisons use within-checkpoint distributions only; there is no clean reference or calibrated statistical null. Confidence is heuristic, not a calibrated probability. Weight-only evidence cannot prove absence of a subtle nonlinear backdoor or verify universal sequence override. A last-token fixed class can also reflect legitimate token-to-class lookup, so that alone would not identify a backdoor. No forward passes, sampled sequences, training, or edits were used.
